title: Masked Encoder Classifier
prompt:
Implement an encoder block and a sequence classifier for padded batches. `MaskedEncoder(embed_dim, num_heads)` receives `x` with shape `(batch, length, embed_dim)` and a boolean `valid_mask` whose True entries are real tokens. It returns `(encoded, attention_weights)`, where `attention_weights` has shape `(batch, num_heads, length, length)`. Invalid keys must have exactly zero attention weight, and changing invalid token values must not affect encoded valid-token outputs. `MaskedEncoderClassifier(encoder, num_labels, pooling="mean")` pools real tokens only and returns `(batch, num_labels)` logits. Support `mean` and `max` pooling.

Validate dimensions, use scaled dot-product attention, and keep all returned values finite.

example.input: encoder(torch.randn(2, 4, 8), torch.tensor([[True, True, False, False], [True, True, True, False]]))
example.output: encoded states and masked attention weights
example.reasoning: Padding is not information and cannot be read by real tokens.
